sections.name: Hyundai Ioniq 5
lines: The Hyundai Ioniq five won World Car of the Year in 2022.
Its pixel style lights and sharp lines are inspired by Hyundai's 1974 Pony concept.
Its eight hundred volt system can charge from ten to eighty percent in about eighteen minutes, on an ultra fast charger.
In India it has a seventy two point six kilowatt hour battery, and a claimed range of six hundred and thirty one kilometres.
A rear motor with two hundred and seventeen P S, and three hundred and fifty newton metres.
A three metre wheelbase gives limousine like legroom, and the centre console slides back and forth.
Vehicle to load lets you power a laptop, or a coffee machine, from the car.
Fast charging, a huge cabin, and a design that still turns heads.
